caption: The drawing depicts a single reddish-brown ceramic jug positioned centrally on a blank, off-white background. The jug features a round, bulbous body with a narrow base and a short neck that flares out to form a wide spout with a gently curved lip. There is a prominent handle attached at one side, which is circular at the top with a smaller circular cutout beneath it. The surface of the jug displays various shades of reddish-brown, with subtle highlights and darker patches suggesting uneven texture or reflections. There is no additional object or decorative element present in the image. The lower right corner of the drawing contains a faint handwritten inscription featuring a name and some numbers.
title: Pitcher
